data.status: Engineering BOM baseline; not released for purchase or unit-cost quotation.
data.quantity_policy: Known quantities are integers; unresolved quantities are null and block cost roll-up. Functional assembly placeholders are not purchasable IC selections.
data.cost_policy: No prices invented. Separate recurring material, conversion, factory overhead, NRE/capital and commercial/service costs. Do not count an OEM subassembly and its included parts twice.
